question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution:
The correct answer is '**difference**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate title of the given passage is 'The Historical Work of Tacitus'.
 
• In the **second** blank, the most appropriate word is 'difference'.
 
• It means 'the way that people or things are not the same or the way that somebody/something has changed'. (अंतर, भेद, फ़र्क़)
 
 
• *Example: What’s the **difference** between this computer and that cheaper one?*
 
 
 
• Let's look at the meaning of other words:
 
 
• **pragmatism**: thinking about solving problems in a practical and sensible way rather than by having fixed ideas. [व्‍यावहारिकता, यथार्थवादिता (न कि सिद्घांतप्रियता)]
 
• **matter**: a subject or situation that you must think about and give your attention to. (विचारणीय और ध्‍यान देने योग्‍य विषय या प्रसंग)
 
• **sample**: a small number or amount of somebody/something that is looked at, tested, examined, etc. to find out what the rest is like. [नमूना (व्‍यक्तियों की थोड़ी संख्‍या या वस्‍तुओं की थोड़ी मात्रा जिसकी जाँच के आधार पर शेष व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु के विषय में पता चले कि वे कैसे या कैसी हैं)]
 
 
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 1.**

 

Correct Passage:__ *If writers only dared to dare, a Suetonius or a Tacitus of the Novel could exist, for the Novel is essentially the history of manners, turned into a story and a play, as is History itself often enough. And there is no other **difference** than this: that the one, the Novel, cloaks its manners (3) ______________ the disguise of invented characters, while the other, History, (4) _______________ names and addresses. Only, the Novel (5) ___________ much deeper than History.*

45:T8c6,

The correct answer is '**under**'.
